parts.text: Aqueous hydrogen peroxide, H 2 O 2 , decomposes to produce water and oxygen gas. Manganese( IV ) oxide is a catalyst in this reaction. A student adds powdered manganese( IV ) oxide to aqueous hydrogen peroxide in a conical flask as shown in Figure 4.1. The volume in the gas syringe is measured at regular time intervals.
